note: target concepts this repo genuinely lacks. Each entry states why and what an agent must not do.

unmatched.reason: The repo has exactly one accent (--accent #5b8cff dark / #2f6bff light). Status hues --amber, --green and --muted are semantic status colours, not a second accent; tokens.test.ts pins the status map to those four tokens only.
unmatched.consequence: Do not invent a secondary accent. Any second accent is a product decision with a token-test update.

unmatched.reason: One border token exists (--border). Measured against --panel it is 1.29:1 in dark and 1.29:1 in light, so every border is a decorative hairline; there is no stronger variant.
unmatched.consequence: Do not raise border contrast by inventing a value. Borders are never the sole carrier of meaning.

unmatched.reason: The repo declares a single shadow, --shadow-fab (0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)), reused by the fab, toast, menu, popover and dialog. No elevation ladder exists.
unmatched.consequence: Do not build an elevation scale. Every floating layer uses --ds-shadow-raised.

unmatched.reason: No dedicated focus colour. The focus ring is `--focus-ring` (2px) drawn in `--accent` via `outline-accent` on every interactive primitive.
unmatched.consequence: Focus always reuses --ds-color-accent at 2px width and 2px offset.

unmatched.reason: Only --radius-md 10px, --radius-lg 12px and --radius-pill 999px are declared. Small corners are written as spacing values (checkbox `rounded-[var(--space-0-2)]`) and the full-screen sheet uses `rounded-none`.
unmatched.consequence: Do not add new radius steps; pick md, lg, pill, the checkbox 0.2rem or 0.

unmatched.reason: The repo declares --font-size 16px, --fs-editor 1.05rem and --leading 1.5 only. Every other text size is a spacing token used in a font-size position (`text-[length:var(--space-0-85)]` etc.).
unmatched.consequence: Sizes in token-map/typography.json are derived names over real spacing tokens; use those values, not new ones.

unmatched.reason: The spacing scale in tokens.css is "exactly the length literals present in globals.css" — 19 irregular sub-rem steps (0.15rem to 5rem), not a geometric scale. tokens.test.ts freezes the inventory.
unmatched.consequence: Use the listed steps verbatim; there is no arithmetic to a missing step.

unmatched.reason: One easing exists (--ease-standard: ease-out) plus two durations (120ms, 200ms). No spring, no linear, no enter/exit pair beyond the snackbar EXIT_MS constant.
unmatched.consequence: Any new curve is a new token decision pinned to tokens.test.ts, not an artefact of this base.

unmatched.reason: Media queries cannot read custom properties, so tokens.css deliberately declares none; the scale lives in BREAKPOINTS in packages/ui/test/tokens.test.ts (sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536).
unmatched.consequence: Breakpoints are a documented scale, not CSS variables. Write the literal with a breakpoint comment.

unmatched.reason: --on-accent is declared once on :root as `white` and never overridden, so light theme keeps white on #2f6bff (measured 4.50:1; the dark pair white on #5b8cff measures 3.16:1).
unmatched.consequence: Do not introduce a second on-accent value for light; the pair is frozen by tokens.test.ts.

unmatched.reason: No gradients exist in the tree; every surface is a flat token fill.
unmatched.consequence: Do not add gradients to any personal-life surface.
